F3D.Title: 3D View
F3D.HUD.ClearConfirm: Reset every square of this scene to height 0?
F3D.HUD.PaintHint: Click a square to raise it, right-click or Shift+click to lower. Drag still moves the camera.
F3D.Notify.NoScene: 3D View: there is no active scene to show.
F3D.Notify.SquareOnly: 3D View only supports square (or gridless) scenes for now.

F3D.Settings.ShowGrid.Hint: Draw grid lines on top of the 3D terrain.
